name: Sika® Injection-111
tagline: Hydrophobic semi flexible polyurethane injection grout
summary: Sika® Injection-111 is a highly expansive hydrophobic MDI based urethane injection grout designed to be used with an accelerator. Sika® Injection-111 reacts when it comes into contact with water to create a hydrophobic foam.
metaDescription: Sika® Injection-111 is a highly expansive hydrophobic MDI based urethane injection grout designed to be used with an accelerator. Sika® Injection-111 reacts when it comes into contact with water to create a hydrophobic foam.
attributes: Reacts with fresh and sea water
Reaction time can be adjusted with catalyst
usage: Seal leaks in concrete, masonry and brickwork
Seal leaks in joints and cracks
advantages: Reacts with fresh and sea water
Reaction time can be adjusted with catalyst
packaging: Sika® Injection-111- 20kg pail Sika® Injection-111C- 2kg bottle (Catalyst)

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: From date of production if stored properly in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5°C and +30°C.

items.text:
Maximum 2500%

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text:
Sika® Injection-111 requires the catalyst Sika® Injection-111C to create a reactive foam for injection.
Typical mix ratios vary from 2-10% of the Sika® Injection-111C depending on the reaction time required, please refer to the reaction table on this PDS for the information.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text: Sika® Injection-111 is typically injected by use of a single component pump that is designed for high pressure use.

items.label: MIXING
items.text: Sika® Injection-111 should be mixed with Sika® Injection-111C using a paddle drill mixer to create a uniform homogeneous liquid for a minimum of 20-30 seconds.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Please consult equipment/pump manufacturer for relative cleaning agent suitable for your individual equipment being used.
